propositions: A stale clone with mismatched or absent epoch must refuse to union at both sync._union_merge and push.py non-FF retry sites instead of silently re-unioning stripped history

The epoch guard must be placed inside sync._union_merge before the merge operation but after merge-base validation, and before both non-FF git merge calls in push_tickets_branch, without blocking ff-adopt or lock acquisition

The epoch field must be added to .store-compat.json as a JSON string (ISO-8601 UTC instant plus random suffix), with the state matrix covering all nine combinations of record presence/absence and epoch presence/absence/mismatch, plus corrupt and unreadable cases

On epoch mismatch or abort condition, sync._union_merge must return without merging and leave the clone unconverged, while push_tickets_branch must return immediately exiting the retry loop without merge or re-push, causing fsck to report DIVERGED with exact local and remote refs preserved

The epoch value is created only during A6-1's re-add commit; write_compat_record must preserve existing valid string epochs and never generate new ones, while older binaries must ignore the unknown epoch field without failure

The guard implementation must distinguish git show failures due to unreadable remote ref from file-absent via separate log messages, emit logger.warning at both sites (not exceptions), and cover all nine state-matrix rows plus corrupt/unreadable scenarios in unit and integration tests
